reuse.why: Puts the holiday match into one isHoliday used by the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend, and handles daily schedules beside the existing getHolidayExdates using RSchedule's exrules, reusing the shared regex constant.

duplication.why: getHolidayExrules repeats getHolidayExdates' daily/skipWeekend guard and filter-map shape, and each of the three RSchedule construction sites now has to make both calls.

placement.why: All holiday interpretation lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing holiday and weekend helpers; server sites only pass the results to RSchedule.

scope.why: Only holiday handling, its call sites, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clear and small, but the two kinds of holiday are split across two exported helpers that every schedule builder must remember to call together; a single helper returning both exdates and exrules would be easier to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Moving paths still go through getDateWithSkippedWeekend and daily paths through the shared holiday helpers; no site parses holidays itself.

disguised_duplication.where: getHolidayExrules in shared/schedules.ts is a reshaped copy of getHolidayExdates (same guard, complementary filter, different map) rather than one function partitioning the holiday list.
